description: This PHP class 'AdministratorAccessSubscriber' is an event subscriber within the OrangeHRM authentication module. It hooks into Symfony's KernelEvents to modify user admin access rights based on the controller handling the request. Specifically, it disables admin access unless the current controller is 'AdminPrivilegeController'.

classes.name: AdministratorAccessSubscriber
classes.description: A Symfony event subscriber class that manages administrator access rights during controller execution events, disabling admin privileges for controllers other than 'AdminPrivilegeController'.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the array of events this subscriber listens to, specifically the KernelEvents::CONTROLLER event with high priority (-10000).

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Handler for the controller event; disables admin rights unless the controller is 'AdminPrivilegeController'.
